mainEntity.name: Do I need a bridge page in an AI sales funnel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bridge page can help explain why a visitor should consider a particular offer after opting in, especially when the lead magnet and paid product need context. It is not automatically necessary; adding a page can also create another drop-off point. Run My AI Business describes funnel components such as opt-in pages, bridge pages, thank-you pages, and email follow-up as pieces that should be tailored to the niche and offer. Decide based on buyer awareness, offer complexity, trust requirements, and whether the thank-you page can do the job clearly. Compare a direct offer path with a bridge-page version and measure the next action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Not always. Use a bridge page when visitors need context, education, or a clear connection between the lead magnet and paid offer. Skip it when it only repeats the opt-in page and adds friction. Compare direct and bridge-page paths using clicks, sales, and drop-off data.
